_doc: 第 2 幕每格的背景描述，Claude 看每格地圖（相機位置、視野）手寫，2026-11-12。不用程式拼。zh 給人看，en 接在 prompt 後面給 Flow。

EP1-02-01.zh: 這是一間又小又亂的學生套房，木頭地板，米白色的牆。鏡頭對著房間最裡面的那面牆。牆的正中間有一扇百葉窗。窗戶下面靠牆放著一張長書桌，差不多跟畫面一樣寬。桌上從左到右放著：檯燈、一疊帳單、學分不足通知、手機、電擊槍。書桌右邊的牆上有一個插座。書桌前面有一張椅子，在畫面中間。畫面左邊是一張沒整理的床，靠著左邊的牆。房門在鏡頭後面，畫面裡看不到。早上的陽光從百葉窗照進來。
EP1-02-01.en: Background: A small, messy student studio apartment with a wooden floor and plain off-white walls. The camera faces the far wall of the room. In the middle of that wall is a window with half-closed blinds. Under the window, a long wooden desk stands against the wall, almost as wide as the picture. On the desk, from left to right: a desk lamp, a stack of bills with red stamps, a notice with a red warning symbol, a phone on a charging cable, a stun gun. On the wall to the right of the desk is a single wall outlet. In front of the desk is a desk chair, in the middle of the picture. On the left side of the picture is an unmade bed against the left wall. The room door is behind the camera and is not in the picture. Morning sunlight comes in through the blinds.

EP1-02-02.zh: 從正上方往下拍書桌桌面。畫面裡只有木頭桌面和那疊帳單；帳單左邊露出一點檯燈的底座，右邊露出一點學分不足通知的邊角。早上的陽光從百葉窗照進來，在桌面上留下一條條光紋。
EP1-02-02.en: Background: Seen from directly above, looking straight down at the wooden desk top. Only the desk surface and the stack of bills are in the picture; the base of a desk lamp just shows at the left edge, and a corner of a notice sheet just shows at the right edge. Morning sunlight through the blinds falls across the desk in stripes.

EP1-02-03.zh: 從斜上方往下拍書桌桌面。學分不足通知斜放在畫面中間，一角壓在左邊那疊帳單上。四周是木頭桌面；畫面最上緣露出一點窗台，百葉窗透進來的陽光在桌面上留下一條條光紋。
EP1-02-03.en: Background: Seen from above at an angle, looking down at the wooden desk top. The notice sheet lies at a slant in the middle of the picture, one corner resting on the stack of bills to its left. Around it is bare desk surface; along the top edge of the picture a strip of the window sill shows, and morning sunlight through the blinds falls across the desk in stripes.

EP1-02-04.zh: 鏡頭在書桌這一邊，對著坐在椅子上的 HERO，所以 HERO 背後是房間的另一頭。HERO 背後是一面空白的米白牆。畫面右邊是那張沒整理的床，靠著右邊的牆；畫面左邊遠處露出房門的一角。畫面下緣露出一點書桌桌面上的雜物。百葉窗在鏡頭後面，看不到；早上的陽光從鏡頭後面照在 HERO 臉上。
EP1-02-04.en: Background: The camera is on the desk side of the room, facing HERO in his chair, so behind HERO we see the other end of the room. Behind HERO is a plain off-white wall. On the right side of the picture is the unmade bed against the right wall; far back on the left side, a corner of the room door shows. Along the bottom edge of the picture a little clutter on the desk top shows. The window with blinds is behind the camera and is not in the picture; morning sunlight comes from behind the camera onto HERO's face.

EP1-02-05.zh: 從斜上方拍書桌桌面。左邊是手機，右邊是電擊槍，並排放在桌上。手機的充電線往畫面右上方拉出去，接到牆上的插座（插座在畫面外）。桌子後面是米白色的牆，畫面上緣露出一點百葉窗的下緣，陽光照在桌面上。
EP1-02-05.en: Background: Seen from above at an angle, looking at the desk top. The phone is on the left and the stun gun on the right, side by side on the desk. The phone's charging cable runs out of the picture toward the upper right, to the wall outlet (the outlet itself is out of the picture). Behind the desk is the plain off-white wall; the bottom edge of the window blinds just shows along the top of the picture, and morning sunlight falls on the desk.

EP1-02-06.zh: 鏡頭平平地對著牆。畫面中間是牆上唯一的插座，只插著一條手機充電線，充電線往左垂下去，接到桌上的手機。畫面左下角是書桌的右端，桌上躺著那把沒插電的電擊槍。其他地方都是空白的米白色牆。
EP1-02-06.en: Background: The camera looks straight at the wall. In the middle of the picture is the only wall outlet in the room, with just one phone charging cable plugged into it; the cable hangs down to the left toward the phone on the desk. In the lower left corner is the right end of the desk, with the unplugged stun gun lying on it. Everything else is plain off-white wall.

EP1-02-07.zh: 從正上方往下拍，手機螢幕幾乎佔滿整個畫面，只在邊緣露出一點木頭桌面，和接在手機底部的充電線。
EP1-02-07.en: Background: Seen from directly above. The phone screen fills almost the whole picture; only a thin strip of wooden desk top shows around the edges, with the charging cable attached to the bottom of the phone.

EP1-02-08.zh: 鏡頭在書桌右端，斜斜地對著坐在椅子上的 HERO，所以 HERO 背後是房間的另一頭。HERO 背後是那張沒整理的床，床靠著畫面右邊的牆；床的左邊是空的木頭地板，再過去是空白的米白牆。畫面下緣是書桌的邊緣。百葉窗和房門都不在畫面裡。早上的陽光從鏡頭後面的百葉窗照進來，照在 HERO 身上。
EP1-02-08.en: Background: The camera is at the right end of the desk, looking at HERO in his chair at an angle, so behind HERO we see the other end of the room. Behind HERO is the unmade bed, against the wall on the right side of the picture; to the left of the bed is empty wooden floor and then a plain off-white wall. Along the bottom edge of the picture is the edge of the desk. The window with blinds and the room door are not in the picture. Morning sunlight comes from the window behind the camera and falls on HERO.

EP1-02-09.zh: 鏡頭在書桌左端，往房門的方向拍。畫面最遠處的正中間是那扇關著的木門，在房間的角落。畫面左邊是空白的米白牆，畫面右邊露出一點床尾。HERO 和門之間是空蕩蕩的木頭地板。書桌和百葉窗在鏡頭後面，看不到；早上的陽光從鏡頭後面照進來。
EP1-02-09.en: Background: The camera is at the left end of the desk, looking toward the room door. Far away in the middle of the picture is the closed wooden door, in the corner of the room. On the left side of the picture is a plain off-white wall; on the right side, the foot of the bed just shows. Between HERO and the door is empty wooden floor. The desk and the window with blinds are behind the camera and are not in the picture; morning sunlight comes from behind the camera.
